title: vosu.status
description: Best-effort, declared common namespace (ADR 0020): the session's coarse game status. Capability id: field:vosu.status(.<path>).

status.description: Coarse status common to rhythm games. A game plugin that fills no fields of this namespace at all omits `vosu.status` entirely (state-schema.md); `null` here means only that an attached, namespace-declaring plugin has not yet determined this session's status (e.g. the first moment after attach, before its first read). A game whose client has no equivalent to one listed value maps to the nearest one rather than inventing a new value.
